Definition: from G5384 and G2237; fond of pleasure, i.e. voluptuous:--lover of pleasure.
BiblicalUsage: Philedonos means a lover of pleasures, voluptuous, and it appears once, in the same list of the last days. Men shall be traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the love of pleasure is the last days' final trade: pleasure instead of God, and a heart that has swapped its first love for its favourite feeling.
